_about: The RV recorder's source table, the choices S19 RV, S20 CAM, S21 CRUISE, S22 NAV (apps/rv_recorder/rv_fields.js is the source; `node tools/road-view/rv_manifest.js export` rewrites this file). READ ONLY: rs (a non-zero getter id), s (a notifier), b (an event). kind full: every message recorded; kind list: the first message whole, then one summary sample a second ("<tag>~1s"), the next message whole after a mark; pick: NAV's allow-list, only those members kept. Ids from the car's catalogue of 2026-11-15 (git-ignored), null when it was not there.
